rv.q: But there’s a ruggedness and rubicund vivacity about him that even the dilapidated detail of his flowing dressing-gown can’t quite hide.
All the elements make you listen and learn afresh to Charles Dickens’ eternal verities about a world where the prosperous and greedy neglect poverty and want at their peril.
This production succeeds in wresting from playgoers far more than just a grin.
As an introduction to Dickens, the production is accessible and very entertaining, with the message of redemption and kindness coming through.
This brilliant production really does do Dickens’ insightful and meaningful story justice.
Imaginatively staged to the point of genius, this multi-sensory production manages to evoke childlike wonder in a show that will undoubtedly manage to melt even the coldest of hearts.

cn.t: The Old Vic's beloved annual production continues to enchant with its fresh, magical staging and fluent direction, though some question whether the casting fully captures Scrooge's accumulated bitterness.
